name: Ne otvorachivajsja ot menja
source:
After events that left deep scars on your psyche, you are finally returning to a normal life. Moving to another city helped you feel safe; the nightmare your obsessed boyfriend put you through in the past is fading, and remission feels so close...

But everything changes. 

The one you desperately tried to forget is back. Disfigured, thirsting for retribution, and still madly obsessed. And he has no intention of forgiving your attempt at betrayal.

[From [url=https://f8zeask.itch.io/dont-turn-away]itch.io[/url]]
